title: Clawd X Digest
summary: 1. **AI Agent Wars**: Claude Code 4.7 and Codex are battling for dominance. Users report massive productivity gains, with zero-knowledge users building web apps in minutes.

2. **Nvidia vs. Anthropic**: Jensen Huang criticizes Dario Amodei's prediction of AI replacing 50% of jobs as "absurd," while SaaS earnings (Atlassian, Twilio) prove resilient against AI disruption fears.
3. **Google DeepMind Insights**: CEO Demis Hassabis emphasizes that model orchestration is becoming more important than the models themselves, as Google shows a credible edge on both flanks.

items.title: Arun (@hiarun02)
items.body: Claude Code 4.7 is insane. i know literally NOTHING about coding. ZERO. and i just built 3 fully functioning web apps in 30 minutes.

items.title: OpenAI (@OpenAI)
items.body: Bring your workflow to Codex in just a few clicks. Import settings, plugins, agents, and project configuration to keep working with fewer interruptions.

items.title: Roland.W (@rwayne)
items.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang pushed back against Dario Amodei's prediction that AI will replace 50% of jobs, calling it 'absurd'.

items.title: Demis Hassabis (@demishassabis)
items.body: Orchestration is what matters now. The model is almost background noise. Google now has a credible argument on both flanks.

items.title: Sam Altman (@sama)
items.body: Hope you are ready for your life to be changed by GPT-6. Math accuracy reported at 92.5%.

items.body: SaaS 'doomsday' postponed: Atlassian, Twilio, and Five9 all beat earnings expectations this week, defying AI disruption fears.
